full_judgment: 2. The facts leading to the issuance of the Rule, in short, is that the complainant Ziaul Haque has been living on .09 acres of land appertaining to plot no. 3169 of khatian no. 1572 of Char Kakra mouza. The accused are also the inhabitants of the same homestead and the homestead is locally known as Sunaddi Bepari Bari. The complainant erected a house in the said land purchasing the same on 22.02.1973 and from then the accused were unhappy and failed to consider the complainant as their good neighbor. As such, they were taking all ill device and measures to drive him away from the said homestead. On 30.1L1990 at 11.30 AM Mizanur Rahman, a minor boy of 5 years and the son of the accused Solaiman  attended to a natural call sitting in the adjacent north side of the kitchen of the complainant upon which the wife of the complainant raised objection but the accused persons being armed with dao, seni, axe, ramda etc. launched on attack on the complainant and his wife. They rebuked the complainant and his wife. The accused persons damaged the fencing of the kitchen. They also took away the fencing and other parts of the kitchen. Accused Solaiman had taken away 5 pools from the kitchen. The accused also had taken away firewood and other utensils from the kitchen. Solaiman set the kitchen on tire also.
